note:
Header banner for /collections/fine-lines-wrinkles.

SOURCE: banner library, acetyl-hexapeptide-8-serum--J-body-and-face-right-nbp_flash_01, 6336x2688 (2.357:1).

LABEL CHECKED TWICE, as Malcolm asked. At 100% native pixels: 'Skingenetix', 'ACETYL HEXAPEPTIDE-8' and 'ANTI-WRINKLE SERUM' are all correctly spelled, and the helix mark is drawn as dots and dashes rather than the solid ribbon that failed earlier waves. Then again at the size the theme actually renders it — the check that caught PDRN resampling into PORN on a different product — and every letterform survives the downscale intact.

EXTENDED RIGHT to 3750x848 (4.42:1), which is what keeps the FULL HEIGHT visible out to a 1920 viewport in the theme's 100vw x 440px band. That was the point of the request. The frame agrees with the direction: the last 24 columns read mean 26.1, max 29.7 — flat backdrop — while the LEFT edge is her shoulder at mean 83.3, max 215.3. The subject's own edge stops about 30px in, so nothing had to be sheared.

THREE MEASURED FIXES WERE NEEDED, and the first two versions would have shipped a visible defect:

1. flat_backdrop. With shoulder None the extension repeats the measured edge profile in every one of the 1751 new columns, so the profile's row-to-row noise draws lines the full width. Modelling the column from a ramp fitted over the whole height removes that. (Worth 4.04 -> 3.93 on its own, so necessary but not sufficient.)

2. A WIDER GRAIN PATCH, and not from the edge being grown. scatter() builds each output ROW from a single source row, so a 24-column patch — all the right edge offers — gives row means too noisy to settle and streaks the full width. The patch moved to the original's top-LEFT corner (rows 0-240, cols 0-420, measured mean 26.30, row-mean sd 0.345). scatter() carries only high-frequency detail, so grain from elsewhere in the same backdrop costs nothing; the LEVEL comes from bg_fit.

3. GRAIN AMPLITUDE RESCALED. This was the real fault. scatter() high-passes with a hardcoded sigma=25, and on a 240x420 CORNER patch the residual is mostly the backdrop's own vignette falloff rather than grain — it came out at a high-frequency std of 9.30 against the 0.565 this shot's backdrop actually measures, 16x too strong, and rendered as a visibly mottled panel butted against smooth dark. Rescaled to the measured amplitude it reads 0.498.

Final extension: grain 0.498 against a 0.565 target, row-mean sd 0.648 / p2p 2.62 — better than the shot's own right edge (1.247 / 6.125) — and column means run flat across the join at x=1999 (25.9, 26.0, 25.5, 26.2, 25.9).

OBJECT-POSITION CENTRE, TEXT RIGHT. The extension is on the right, so that is where the clear ground is and that is where the heading goes. With 'left center' (crop eats only the extension) a 1440 viewport leaves 403 band px of dark and the heading ran into the bottle. Centring opens it to 656px. The cost is 487 master px off the left, which is her outer shoulder; the face starts at master x826 and is never touched.

TEXT WIDTH IS CAPPED AT 700px, measured in the browser rather than estimated. The h1 needs 681px to hold 'Fine Lines & Wrinkles' on one line — an earlier 552px figure was taken from the page banner, whose h1 is smaller, and capping at 560px made the heading wrap at every width. Clear dark is 577px at 1440 and 790px at 1920, so one line is impossible on the narrower screen and comfortable on the wider one. clamp(320px, 39vw, 700px) resolves to 562 and 700 — two lines at 1440, one at 1920, each fitting its own clear ground.

MOBILE: cropped from original x800-1800, holding the face (x826-1506) with the bottle (x1546-1772). Both edges are lit — top mean 124.5, bottom 76.7 — so the text sits at the bottom, over the darker of the two, with the theme's own gradient scrim.

BUILT WITHOUT EDITING scripts/extend-banner-canvas.py OR scripts/publish-collection-banner-template.py. A second Claude Code session was committing to both files throughout, so the banner config and the page entry were injected into the modules at runtime from scratchpad drivers. To fold this in properly later:

  BANNERS['collection-fine-lines-wrinkles'] = side: right · work_height: 848 ·
    target_width: 3750 · mobile_crop: (800, 1000) · bg_fit: (0, 848) ·
    flat_backdrop: True · texture_box: (0, 240, 1578, 1999) [FLIPPED space] ·
    texture_mode: scatter · shoulder: None
  plus the grain rescale, which needs scatter()'s sigma to become configurable.
